claims.text: IV PPI (eg, pantoprazole, esomeprazole, lansoprazole) may be started if poss upper GI bleed; use if a gastroduodenal ulcer = confirmed as the source.
claims.quote: An IV proton pump inhibitor (PPI) (eg, pantoprazole, esomeprazole, lansoprazole) may be started in cases of possible upper GI bleeding and should be used if a gastroduodenal ulcer is confirmed as the source of bleeding
